annotations.title: Find a business by what it does and where

description: Businesses that confirmed their own facts at INITE, found by what they do and where: a kind of business or the service wanted, in English, Russian, Portuguese or Spanish ("a dentist in Lisbon", "кафе в Москве", "advogado trabalhista São Paulo"), with an optional city, country and language. Each answer gives the business's name, what it does in its own words, its city, its first services with prices exactly as the business confirmed them, its site, and its company facts server (MCP and A2A) to ask for the rest - hours, every service, questions and answers - or to send it a request where it takes them. INITE Directory covers businesses whose owners confirmed their facts at INITE and proved their domain; the INITE Atlas is AI tools and software scored by INITE's own measurement (match_tools, atlas_lookup on the Atlas server) - use it, not this, for which AI tool or app to use. Ordered by how well the words match and how complete the confirmed facts are; no business can pay for a place. Free, no account.

city.description: Only businesses with a location in this city, in any spelling ("Lisboa", "Lisbon")

country.description: Only businesses with a location in this country: a name in any of the four languages, or its two-letter code

language.description: A language the business serves in, as a code ("pt") or a name; businesses that name none come after the rest

query.description: What the business is or does, or what the person wants from it, e.g. "dentist", "wedding photographer", "corte de cabelo masculino". A place in it counts too.
